description: The plot illustrates the relationship between the number of epochs and WER (Word Error Rate) for different fine-tuning configurations of the Whisper model, specifically for the "small" type. The x-axis represents the epoch, with a linear scale, ranging from 0 to 6, and tick labels at every integer value. The y-axis represents WER, also with a linear scale, ranging from 25.0 to 42.5, with tick labels at every 2.5 units. The plot displays four lines, each representing a different configuration: "small AdaLoRA_int4" (solid orange line with circle markers), "small AdaLoRA_int8" (dashed orange line with square markers), "small int4" (dashed orange line with circle markers), and "small int8" (solid orange line with square markers). The "small AdaLoRA_int4" line starts at approximately 35.5 WER at epoch 0 and decreases to around 30.5 WER at epoch 6. The "small AdaLoRA_int8" line begins at about 30.0 WER at epoch 0, increases to a peak of around 42.0 WER at epoch 2, and then decreases to approximately 26.0 WER at epoch 6. The "small int4" line starts at around 30.0 WER at epoch 0 and decreases to about 25.5 WER at epoch 6. The "small int8" line begins at approximately 35.0 WER at epoch 0 and decreases to around 30.0 WER at epoch 6.
